deviation_mechanism: The 28-layer design space creates a high-dimensional optimization manifold where unconstrained initialization frequently drives parameters into physically prohibited regions. Without structural priors, the sampler generates extreme thickness asymmetries that breach total-film-budget or sharp-gradient manufacturability constraints. Rapid optical-path transitions between heavily over-thickened and severely under-thickened layers increase numerical stiffness and trigger hard rejection filters during validation, which collapses the viable candidate pool before the optimizer can refine solutions.
continue_rationale: Only 1 round has executed. Although valid_candidates dropped to 2 (falling short of the 5–10 projection), the primary scientific signal—the successful generation of highly non-periodic thickness distributions—was captured immediately, and the objective function registers a definitive anchor value (0.618241). insight_for_next: Shift from purely randomized initialization to a locally-biased scheme: partition the 28 layers into 14 contiguous bilayer units. Initialize each unit around nominal quarter-wave optical thicknesses (±15% tolerance) and apply a soft penalty during the optimizer's initial pass to prevent inter-layer thickness jumps exceeding 40%. This preserves global non-periodicity across the stack while drastically increasing the probability that candidates satisfy physical budget constraints.
